title: Tesla Deep: CAN-bus telemetry for a Model 3
summary: Decodes 2,700 signals off a Tesla Model 3's vehicle bus: individual cell voltages, motor and inverter temps, real pack capacity, power analytics, all in a live web dashboard.
how_to_use: See README.md and docs/HARDWARE.md for the adapter you need, then ./run.sh.
requires: A Tesla Model 3/Y, a CAN adapter (see docs/HARDWARE.md), Python 3.
